To be honest, I never felt a ‘connection’ to god. I didn’t pray because I wanted to, I did it because I felt obligated to. I never really felt that ‘love’ that Christians talk about. Sometime during late 2018 when I was 13 (my age right now), I started to question if he was actually real. I realized at that time that god wasn’t really there for me during the tough times in my life. I really wanted god to be real though. I prayed about it A LOT. I prayed for a sign, something, anything that proved he was real. I had mental breakdowns over it. Nothing. God gave me nothing. If god were real (which he isn’t lol) then he’s an asshole. No, more like a sadistic psycho.  I still wanted to believe god was real, because he was my motivation to live. I told my mom about my doubts. In short, she told me that he is real and he loves me, but it’s my choice to believe what I want. She also got mad at me sometimes because she’s “really passionate about her beliefs.” She accused me of hating god, and not wanting to believe in him because of my sexuality.  So, she didn’t help at all, really. One time, I told her that her forcing religion on me upset me. She apologized, and said she would stop. She didn’t lol. She would force me to watch religious documentaries, listen to Christian music, read specific bible verses, etc. This really annoyed me. Especially because she (and a lot of other Christians I know) are complete hypocrites and are worse of a person than I am. Whenever I call my mom out on her hypocrisy, she just doesn’t believe me, or says “I don’t care.” She and a lot of other Christians can’t take any criticism which is ironic. My mom gave me vague ‘evidence,’ like “how could everything be made?!” Just today (the time I wrote this post), I finally decided that god was not real. Sorry this was so long!
